_note: Blended USD per million tokens (input + cache + output summed) per model family, fitted to recorded runs.jsonl lines holding usage and a real cost_usd. cost_estimate.py selftest checks it stays within 35 percent per model. usage_input is USD per million input tokens fitted to the host totals in docs/reports/subagent-mode-live-2026-10-07/host-cost.txt (T-0328); usage_multipliers scale it for output, cache read and cache write tokens. usage_calibration (T-0332) multiplies the transcript input and output counts (last line per message id): the host reports input about 200 to 250 times and output about 1.25 times the transcript's (R1 verifier input 260 vs 51956, output 14852 vs 18417; final-rerun verifier input 486 vs 120787, output 20945 vs 27041), while the cache fields match exactly; fitted on those two rows plus the L2 opus verifier, estimate/host 0.83 to 0.93. haiku is scaled from its blended rate, not fitted.
